name: credit-score
title: Credit Score
description: A credit score card whose number counts up while a bar meter lights from red through amber to green.

perf.budget: The meter lights bar by bar with UI-thread timings; the number counts up for about a second (re-rendering on animation frames).

measurements.notes: Janky frames come from the number counting up (a React re-render per frame for about a second).

a11y.reducedMotion: The score shows at once and the bars light without the left-to-right sweep.
a11y.screenReader: The score reads as one line with its band and scale ("Your credit score is 712, Good, on a scale of 300 to 850").
a11y.touchTarget: The header button is at least 44 pt.
